newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - IMC Global EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - IMC Global EPS view cut.

text.p: Natwest Markets analyst David Nelson said Monday he reduced his fiscal 1998 earnings estimate for fertilizer company IMC Global Inc to $2.65 a share from $3.00.
-- said he cut the estimate to reflect dilution and goodwill from IMC's proposed $800 million acquisition of Freeport-McMoRan Inc.

-- IMC said in a statement that it intends to restructure its balance sheet to make its capital structure more efficient and to "largely eliminate" any earnings per share dilution that would occur otherwise.
-- Nelson said he continues to have an accumulate rating on the stock.
-- IMC Global shares were off 3/4 at 33.
